About Heidi Systems
Heidi Systems is building the data infrastructure layer for buildings and energy. We help property owners and managers digitize metering, consumption data, reporting, and billing workflows in one of the largest and most outdated infrastructure markets in Europe.
We are looking for a skilled frontend engineer who wants to own the product layer that makes complex infrastructure data legible, actionable, and fast. You will work directly on our SvelteKit application — the interface through which property managers, operations teams, and customers interact with our systems every day.
This is not a typical frontend role. You will work with real data from real buildings, build tools that handle high-volume consumption data, and collaborate closely with backend engineers and the founding team. You own what you build.
Tasks
What you will work on
Build and improve our SvelteKit web application from the ground up
Write strongly typed TypeScript across all layers of the frontend
Implement server-side rendering, routing, and load functions in SvelteKit
Build and maintain reusable UI components with Tailwind CSS and DaisyUI
Integrate with backend APIs via oRPC and shape the contract between frontend and backend
Write reliable tests with Vitest and JSDom
Work with Bun as the runtime and for CLI scripting
Improve developer tooling, code quality, and frontend reliability
Debug real-world issues across APIs, data pipelines, and the UI layer
Work closely with the founding team on product and architecture decisions

We are looking for someone unusually strong, precise, and product-minded.
You should be excited about building clean, performant interfaces on top of complex data systems. You do not need to know everything already, but you should learn fast, think from first principles, and care about the end result.

s.h: You are a great fit if you
s.t:
Have 1–2+ years of professional experience with SvelteKit and TypeScript
Understand the Svelte reactivity model, stores, and component lifecycle deeply
Write strict, idiomatic TypeScript — generics, utility types, no implicit any
Are comfortable in Unix-based development environments
Care about code quality, reliability, and shipping things that actually work
Enjoy working close to real data and complex product requirements
Like fast-moving environments with high ownership and responsibility
Have a portfolio or GitHub profile you are proud of
Tech stack
SvelteKit · TypeScript · oRPC · Tailwind CSS · DaisyUI · Vitest · JSDom · Bun · Git
Zod · Drizzle ORM · PostgreSQL · Bun workspaces · Auth patterns (sessions, JWT, OAuth) · German: professional working proficiency · Open-source contributions

Work directly with the founding team
Own real technical projects from day one
Learn how to build infrastructure for a fast-growing startup
Get exposure to DevOps, data architecture, IoT, energy, and real estate infrastructure
Help shape the technical foundation of a company tackling a huge, outdated market
High ownership, high learning curve, high impact
Location

Start
As soon as possible.

Send us a short note, your CV or GitHub profile, and ideally one project you are proud of.

About A1 There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks that are not AI-native. Our mission is to build a proactive smart assistant for everyday users to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior.

Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time. Role You will own how this system behaves on desktop environments. Your work focuses on reliability, performance, and real-time behavior in production desktop applications. Focus Build and maintain cross-platform desktop applications using Electron.

Design responsive and scalable UIs for real-time collaboration. Implement desktop-specific functionality including file system access, native notifications, auto-updates, and deep linking. Integrate AI-powered features (chat, agents, AI assistance) via backend APIs. Optimize startup time, memory usage, and runtime performance.

Profile and reduce Electron overhead. Manage large local state and message history efficiently. Ensure smooth real-time updates (messages, typing indicators, presence). Maintain stability across macOS and Windows environments. Ideal Experiences Proven software engineering experience. Hands-on experience building production Electron applications.

Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript. Experience with React or similar UI frameworks. Solid understanding of the desktop application lifecycle. Experience with IPC communication. Experience working with local storage (SQLite, IndexedDB, filesystem). Experience with WebSockets or other real-time transport mechanisms.

Strong debugging and performance profiling skills. Familiarity with native OS behaviors on macOS or Windows. Tech Stack Electron Node.js Typescript SQl & noSQL How We Work The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team.

We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently.

Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product Interview process If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews. Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally. Originally posted on Himalayas

Du programmierst selbst und entwickelst anspruchsvolle digitale Lösungen, je nach Projekt beispielsweise in Anwendungslogik, Frontend, Backend, Schnittstellen, Automatisierungen oder AI-Komponenten.

Du begleitest Vorhaben von der ersten Analyse über Konzeption und Umsetzung bis zum produktiven Einsatz und übernimmst Verantwortung für Nutzen, Qualität und Projekterfolg.
Qualifikation
Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Entwicklung anspruchsvoller digitaler Lösungen oder in technischer Projekt- oder Produktarbeit mit hohem Umsetzungsanteil.
Du kannst fachliche Zusammenhänge schnell erfassen und mit Kunden auf Augenhöhe über Prozesse, Anforderungen und Lösungsmöglichkeiten sprechen.
Du verfügst über fundierte Programmierkenntnisse und ein gutes Verständnis von Softwarearchitektur, APIs, Datenmodellen und Tests. So kannst du Lösungen selbst implementieren und weiterentwickeln, fundierte Architekturentscheidungen treffen und die Qualität von Implementierungen beurteilen.
Du hast Erfahrung mit modernen, professionellen Technologie-Stacks – zum Beispiel TypeScript und Node.js, C# und .NET oder vergleichbaren typisierten Sprachen und Plattformen.
Du nutzt AI-Tools nicht nur für einzelne Code-Vorschläge, sondern auch für Analyse, Spezifikation, Umsetzung, Testing und Review.
Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, kommunizierst direkt und machst Risiken, Abhängigkeiten und offene Entscheidungen frühzeitig sichtbar.

Runa is pioneering a first-of-its-kind payment rail that enables the seamless, global money movement at scale. Runa transforms this landscape by providing a new digital payments infrastructure that empowers businesses to send digital money instantly and cost-free to anyone, anywhere. Running a frontline business is an operational puzzle most software has never touched. Shift-by-shift labour costs, compliance that changes by region and by role, and margins thin enough that a badly built rota can sink a quarter. It's a harder problem than most white-collar SaaS, and yet frontline sectors employ 80% of the global workforce and have received about 1% of the last decade's software investment.
We think that's because the problem needed AI, not just better software, before it was solvable. Frontline organisations sit on enormous amounts of operational data. Used properly, that data lets agents take on real parts of running the business rather than just reporting on it. That's what we're building at Sona, and it's early enough that the systems you build now will still be foundational in three years.
We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here .

We're hiring Senior Software Engineers to join our product teams and help build the next generation of workforce management. This isn't a traditional engineering role - at Sona, engineers are deeply embedded in the product development process, working directly with customers to understand their pain points and turning those insights into shipped solutions.
AI tooling is central to how we work. Coding agents produce the majority of our code, and your job is to direct, correct, and architect - not type every line yourself. You'll use tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or similar as a core part of your daily workflow, and we'll assess that proficiency as part of the interview process. To do that well, you need strong Elixir expertise - enough to know when an agent's output is wrong and how to fix it.
Day to day, you'll work within a cross-functional product team with significant autonomy over how to reach outcomes. You'll participate in defining features and scope from PR FAQs and kick-off conversations rather than picking up fully specified tickets. You'll also have the opportunity to rotate across different product domains throughout the year - scheduling, payroll, HR, staff engagement - giving you breadth that most engineering roles don't offer.
This role is remote-first for anyone based in a European timezone, with quarterly in-person team alignment sessions and client workshops in London. It's not a fully isolated remote setup - you'll need flexibility to travel for the moments that matter.

What's it all about? The balance of power in the energy industry needs to change. The intermittency of renewable supply and the constant demands of the grid mean that we still rely on less efficient, more expensive and unsustainable fossil fuels to keep the lights on. At Gridfuse, our mission is to shift this balance through technology. To shift the balance of inputs, so that renewables become the world's main source of electricity.
At Gridfuse, we develop the software that controls real renewable energy assets and turns them into a coordinated Virtual Power Plant (VPP) that can respond intelligently to energy markets and grid conditions.
Your impact As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build the systems that connects our platform to these assets and turn energy-market and grid requirements into real-world actions. Your code will influence when batteries charge or discharge, how renewable assets respond, and how reliably these assets can participate in the electricity system.
You will own and evolve core parts of the Control services, working closely with other software engineers and our renewable-energy experts.
The role Design and build distributed control systems that coordinate fleets of batteries, wind turbines and solar plants
Translate complex energy-market and grid requirements into reliable software behaviour
Build the services responsible for communicating with physical assets and processing their telemetry, status and capabilities
Design systems that continue to behave predictably when devices fail, networks are unreliable, messages arrive late or assets become temporarily unavailable
Build highly observable and resilient services that operate continuously in production
Take your services from architecture and implementation through deployment, monitoring and operation
Work closely with energy-market specialists to understand the problem and turn it into pragmatic technical solutions
Make architectural and technical decisions that balance reliability, scalability, simplicity and delivery speed
Mentor other engineers and raise the technical bar across the team

You have experience designing and architecting distributed systems

Immuware's customers, including Employee Health nurses; occupational health managers; and compliance professionals, work in one of the most requirement-heavy environments in healthcare IT. Regulations shift. Organizational structures change. New workflows emerge. Each of these changes often means hands-on work is needed inside their Immuware environment.
The Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) exists to meet that need. It's a technical role embedded in the post-sales customer experience. It is not account management, not billable project work, and not break-fix support. The FDE shows up on customer calls, understands exactly what a health-system nurse manager is trying to accomplish, and gets it done.

This is a process that happens through configuration, scripting, integrations, or code, and by partnering with product and engineering when the problem is bigger than one person.
The FDE owns the technical depth: live solutioning, hands-on building, and the bridge between customer needs and internal product and engineering teams.

As our Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) you will own the technical resolution of customer problems end to end, from understanding the need, building the fix, landing it with product and engineering when it's bigger than you, to ultimately serve as the bridge between customer needs and internal product and engineering teams. You're measured on customer outcomes, not on activity.
This role partners closely with our Customer Success Managers, who own the overall customer relationship, strategy, and commercial outcomes.
Technical Solutioning & Building
Lead regular (often weekly) technical working sessions with customers to address actively evolving needs driven by regulatory changes, organizational shifts, and workflow updates.
Configure, script, and-where it's the right tool-write code to solve customer needs: workflow setup, rule-building, field configuration, user and role management, reporting, data corrections, integrations, and small platform changes.
Translate complex Employee Health requirements (OSHA compliance, state-specific immunization mandates, system credentialing workflows, and the like) into solutions that actually work for our clients, in the Immuware platform (open to suggestions!) .
Question the requirements: Challenge requests that don't serve the customer's real goal, and choose the simplest solution that solves the underlying problem.
Thoroughly document your solution designs in Notion, while updating live items in Jira, to ensure they are repeatable and transferable.
Generalize your work. Turn one-off fixes into reusable templates, decision trees, or product improvements so the next customer benefits.
Triage net-new module or record-type additions that need a formal Letter of Work (LOW) and/or an ARR change (expansion) to CSMs and Professional Services.
Customer Partnership
Serve as the technical counterpart to CSMs on customer calls. CSMs handle the relationship; you handle "how do we make it work."
Working alongside the CSMs, lead deeper, in-depth customer education beyond basic platform navigation, run workflow specific walkthroughs, and re-train as staff turnover and organizational change creates knowledge gaps.
Build trusted-advisor relationships with power users and technical contacts at customer organizations.
Spot configuration gaps or risks before they turn into escalations.
Stay aware of each assigned customer's environment, history, and upcoming needs.
Product & Engineering Collaboration
Partner directly with product and engineering: open pull requests, pair on fixes, and reproduce or root-cause issues in the codebase where you can.
Monitoring surface patterns across customers: repeated requests, regulatory gaps, and workflow limitations, and bring them to Product with specificity and customer context.
Contribute to the internal knowledge base: common configurations, decision trees, scripts, and workarounds, so the team scales.
Support Bridge & Scoping
Fix what you can, and hand off a clean, dev-ready ticket for what you can't. Identify potential bugs or system issues, partner with development to solve for the root cause, and reproduce solutions at scale.
Write clear, well-scoped bug reports and feature requests that enable engineering to act without back-and-forth.
Confidently identify and navigate between "I can fix this," "this needs a support ticket," and "this needs a product change."
What This Role Is Not
Not account ownership. CSMs own renewals, expansion, and the executive relationship. The FDE supports those relationships through technical excellence.
Not billable Professional Services. PS handles formal implementation projects with SOWs. The FDE handles ongoing, post-go-live technical needs as part of the customer's subscription.
Not the L1/L2 support queue. The support team owns routine bug triage. This FDE will do deeper scoping and fixes, ensuring a clean handoff. It does not replace the support workflow.
You'll Thrive in This Role If You
Are energized by customer calls and like solving problems live, not async.
Can read a healthcare compliance requirement and immediately start thinking about how to model and build it in a SaaS platform.
Have a builder's mindset: you're systematic, you test your own work, you write code when it's the right tool, and you don't leave a solution half-done.
Can switch comfortably between explaining something to an IT admin, a head nurse, a customer executive, and your own engineering team.
Are naturally organized. You manage several customers with different environments and needs at once.
Get frustrated by workarounds and push internally for real solutions.

5+ years in a technical, customer-facing role (solutions engineer, implementation consultant, technical account manager, or forward deployed engineer) handling client resolutions, both live (virtually) and post meeting action items, and know how to navigate delays while staying calm under pressure and maintaining the clients trust.
4-5 years navigating Azure, JavaScript, and Typescript with a strong background in SQL and Azure SQL database management.
2-3+ experience operating in Notion and Jira .
Proficiency in C#, and comfort reading a codebase, debugging, and writing scripts or small features. track record of building on SaaS platforms, not just toggling settings: creating non-trivial workflows, rules, forms, reports, integrations, or role and permission structures.

## Ingénieur logiciel embarqué senior (Firmware / Zephyr RTOS). ##
En tant que développeur senior, vous rejoindrez une équipe dynamique travaillant sur un projet stratégique. Vous travaillerez aux côtés d'un développeur et d'un lead développeur pour contribuer au développement et à l'optimisation du firmware pour de nouveaux produits de pointe.
La plateforme est construite autour d'un microcontrôleur Alif Semiconductor (Arm Cortex-M) en tant que processeur principal, combiné à une puce sans fil Infineon pour la connectivité RF (Wi-Fi / Bluetooth LE).

* Développer et maintenir le firmware en C/C++, principalement sur Zephyr RTOS.
* Travailler sur les microcontrôleurs Arm Cortex-M d'Alif Semiconductor, y compris la gestion du bootloader et les mises à jour du firmware.
* Intégrer et interfacer les chipsets sans fil Infineon (Wi-Fi, BLE) avec le processeur principal.
* Concevoir et implémenter des pilotes pour divers périphériques, tels que les composants d'interface utilisateur (boutons, capteurs capacitifs, capteurs analogiques, actionneurs haptiques).
* Développer et intégrer des interfaces de communication : Wi-Fi, UART, et protocoles propriétaires sur interfaces série (SPI).
* Contribuer aux tests du firmware, à l'automatisation des tests et aux pipelines CI.
* Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe pour assurer une intégration fluide et des performances optimales du firmware.

* Plus de 3 ans d'expérience en développement logiciel embarqué / firmware en C/C++
* Connaissance experte de Zephyr RTOS
* Expérience pratique solide avec les microcontrôleurs Arm Cortex-M (par exemple STM32, Nordic nRF, Alif), y compris les bootloaders (par exemple MCUboot)
* Bonne connaissance des interfaces et protocoles de communication : Wi-Fi, UART, SPI
* Expérience d'intégration de chipsets ou modules sans fil avec un microcontrôleur hôte

* Expérience pratique avec les outils et processus CI
* Expérience d'utilisation d'outils d'automatisation sur plateformes Windows et Linux
* Bonne compréhension des meilleures pratiques de développement logiciel
* Forte conviction et expérience des méthodologies Agile
* Excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes et esprit collaboratif orienté service
* Capacité à communiquer clairement des concepts techniques complexes
* Compétences relationnelles : authenticité, ouverture, collaboration, humilité, curiosité et propension à l'action
